stages.title: tensor graph (input to run_rangeify)
stages.desc: After transform_to_call + prepare_rangeify: PARAMs instead of buffers, STORE/AFTER for outputs, movement ops still present.

stages.title: apply rangeify
stages.desc: pm_apply_rangeify: movement ops are gone, every buffer access is INDEX(buf, idx-expr), realized values are wrapped in STAGE (=BUFFERIZE) closing their ranges.

stages.title: symbolic + debuf
stages.desc: symbolic + pm_reduce_simplify + pm_const_buffer_folding + pm_remove_bufferize: cheap STAGEs are removed (recomputed), index math simplified.

stages.title: stage to store
stages.desc: pm_add_buffers / bufferize_to_store: each surviving STAGE becomes ALLOC + INDEX + STORE + END(ranges) wrapped in AFTER.

stages.title: split kernels
stages.desc: split_kernels: every STORE/END with no open ranges becomes SINK(KernelInfo).call(*buffers) — one CALL per kernel.

passes.name: remove views from the kernel graph
lower copy kernels to STORE calls
